notes: Site plan (left panel). Scale bar 0-15 m = 84 px (small print; same bar layout as the 19th-floor plan's 0/1.5/15 m bar). North point straight left (90° anticlockwise of plan up). Stack numbers printed on the plan; block names are not printed, so stacks 01-04 are Blk 6C and 05-06 Blk 6D per the unit list. Blk 6C core at the white cross between its four units; Blk 6D core at the middle of its footprint.
